Every shipped engineering protocol is a Canon `protocol/1` document at `protocols/<name>/<major>.yaml`. Each page here is generated from the document's compiled form, `canon-ir/1`, so it shows what Canon understood.

| Protocol | Revision | Description | Declares |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`eval.gated_change/1`](./eval-gated-change/1.mdx) | 1 | Decide one change an automated loop made to an agent's text or configuration (guidance, a system prompt, tool caps) against an evaluation set: keep it only on evidence about that exact candidate revision, from a producer the case lists as another agent run than the one that wrote it, that the evaluation design passed review, the change stays inside the surface the loop may change and carries no leaked or forbidden content, it improved on the tuning split and the improvement reproduced, and the held-out split did not regress; reject it when every one of those is decided and one is false; propose it to a person when it leaves the surface; or close the case inconclusive on an explicit decision. The candidate's revision hashes its content together with its basis (baseline, question set, data revision and design), so a moved basis is a new candidate revision and evidence about the old one no longer counts. Missing, stale or non-independent evidence leaves a claim unknown, and unknown neither keeps nor rejects. | 7 claims, 6 actions, 0 obligations, 4 outcomes |
| [`incident.response/1`](./incident-response/1.mdx) | 1 | Respond to an incident through two obligations that progress independently: restore\_service, on which emergency mode is left, and investigate\_cause, which stays open after emergency mode ends until a cause analysis of a current revision of the service or the release identifies the cause. A rollback of the release is verified only on a complete rollback result from a verifier the case lists as another principal than the one who rolled it back. The service is healthy only on an observation at most 30 minutes old. | 4 claims, 6 actions, 2 obligations, 0 outcomes |
| [`ml.experiment/1`](./ml-experiment/1.mdx) | 1 | Test a hypothesis by experiment: run a candidate against a baseline on a frozen dataset snapshot under a reviewed design, and close the case supported when the experiment is valid and its result reproducible, beats the baseline and is robust; refuted when a valid, reproducible result does not beat the baseline; invalid when the experiment itself is not valid; or inconclusive or superseded on an explicit decision. | 5 claims, 0 actions, 0 obligations, 5 outcomes |
| [`software.change/1`](./software-change/1.mdx) | 1 | Deliver a change to a software system: implement it, verify the current implementation revision, merge it under authority, release and deploy it, and accept it once its objective is realized; or close it declined, superseded or abandoned on an explicit decision, or rolled back on a complete rollback result. A case fixes its risk, which selects the obligations that apply, and its change kind, which selects whether a regression must be reproduced before the implementation is edited, and whether its regression test must fail on its first run, before the implementation is first changed; and whether it affects a security boundary, in which case the implementation is verified only once a principal other than the implementer approved its security review. A deployment is healthy only on an observation at most 30 minutes old. | 9 claims, 6 actions, 6 obligations, 5 outcomes |
| [`support.triage/1`](./support-triage/1.mdx) | 1 | Triage one support ticket: read it at its current revision, know who raised it, have a proposed classification reviewed, and route it under authority; escalate under authority when its service-level target is breached, and hand it to a person when it cannot be triaged. | 9 claims, 7 actions, 1 obligations, 3 outcomes |
